notes.title: Build 840
notes.content:
Howdy folks! Just summarizing a bunch of small quality of life changes that have come through in the last few patches:
[list]
[*] fixed a rare issue with music in the second intro level
[*] fixed an issue with save file upgrades
[*] "relaxing" characters get access to basic Organize and Inspect abilities

notes.title: Overland now has all-dog squads in newest update
notes.content:
Despite being very, very bad at its turn-based tactical survival, I quite enjoy Overland. I always welcome a reason to jump back in and utterly fail at surviving an apocalyptic road trip across the country. Finji have given me another fantastic reason to get back behind the wheel. In its newest update, Overland adds an “all dogs” setting that guarantees your squad will only be made up of furry friends. Also there are pugs now.

(more…)

notes.title: Post-apocalyptic road-trip strategy Overland has a big 1.2 update with an all-dogs mode
notes.content:
Possibly one of the most stylish turn-based strategy games around and one that's also rather difficult, Overland just had a big 1.2 update released with some funny new additions.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/09/post-apocalyptic-road-trip-strategy-overland-has-a-big-12-update-with-an-all-dogs-mode

notes.title: Overland v1.2 Now Available
notes.content:
[b]Overland Version 1.2 is now available![/b] Explore the end of the world with new pug dog companions and new rest stop levels. Enjoy the new introduction and prologue! This version includes 3 new difficulty settings, 7 new game modifiers including all dogs mode, tourist mode, and expert settings. You can browse records from your past trips and check out updated badge and stats displays. Overland v1.2 also includes dialog, item and environment updates to make Overland even better.
[list]
[*] [b]Pugs![/b] They're very cute I promise
[*] [b]Rest stops![/b] Take a breather halfway through each biome (if you need one).
[*] [b]New introduction and prologue! [/b]Includes spooky lore :O
[*] [b]3 new difficulty settings! [/b]Includes a new normal mode for players new to the adventure.
[*] 7 new gameplay modifiers including [b]all-dogs mode,[/b] tourist mode, and expert settings
[*] Updated badges and stats display
[*] Browse records of past trips!
[*] Dialog, item, and environment updates
[/list]
Game development during a plague year is never really exactly how you want things to go, but we've been creating and testing these changes since about January, and are so happy with how they've turned out. We hope you enjoy them too!

notes.title: Build 751 - The Little Things
notes.content:
Since the last patch notes, we've added a bunch of little things to improve the overall feel of the game, including:
[list]
[*] Hint outlines to help new players find good scavenging spots
[*] Organize window can support Large UI mode
[*] Improved vista rendering performance
[*] Streamlined some campfire/map transitions
[*] Fixed some glitches in the vehicle animations
[*] Fixed some mouse UI stuff
[/list]
And a handful of fiddly other bits. I think this is the last v1.1 patch - we're already working on v1.2, so it's gonna be a while before another update drops here. I'm really excited about the stuff we're adding, but localizing into almost 20 languages means it might be a bit of a wait, so thanks in advance for your patience!

notes.title: Build 742 - Pat Buffs + Audio/UI Fixes
notes.content:
Rebalancing a live game can be a really controversial process but I'm really excited to share with you all that patting dogs now costs zero action points. I think this is a game changer for our competitive players and I'm excited to see what they do with this buff. Other changes include:
[list]
[*] new quicksand crater visuals
[*] changed inspect and organize to have full black backgrounds
[*] added 0.1s show/hide fades to a lot of the level UI elements
[*] adjusted the timing of title screen and level exit fades
[*] boatloads of overdue audio fixes
[/list]
I know I keep saying this is the last one before we buckle down to start work on the bigger update but I keep finding things from the bigger update that is fun to share earlier. We'll probably have another patch next week too! Thanks and have a good weekend?

notes.title: Build 733
notes.content:
This week was all about refinement - lots of little UI, level generation, audio, and graphics improvements in this patch:
[list]
[*] Re-skinned the Inspect view to match the Organize view!
[*] Re-did some of the trading site logic so that traders usually start out next to tables (seems small but feels so nice)
[*] Added new end-of-level audio cues that change depending on failure/victory/etc
[*] Increased survivor movement speed by almost 10%. Feels nice!
[*] Fixed some long-standing bugs with audio and lighting
[*] Various balance + difficulty changes
[/list]
We've got one more small, mostly-audio patch coming early next week and then we'll be focusing on the big final content drop!

notes.title: Build 724 - [REDACTED] sighted in the Grasslands...

notes.title: Build 713 Available Now
notes.content:
Hey folks! Thanks for bearing with us over this holiday break, and giving us a bit of time to work on the vinyl release. Build 713 is live now with a bunch of little features and fixes:

[list]
[*] Dogs can pull people into cars now
[*] Organize view available in more situations
[*] Added new cold-weather idle animation in snowy levels
[*] Stealing cars and gas will count as burglary again
[*] Fixed missing Steam Overlay / Achievements on Mac OS 10.15
[*] Fixed a level generator issue with searchable barrels
[*] Fixed rare issues with the quicksand and falling objects events
[*] Fixed organize view rendering issue with certain trades
[*] Fixed animation issue with lit flares and the relax poses
[*] Fixed issue with beach campfire showing up in the organize view
[*] Adjusted some introduction pacing stuff
[*] Texture maintenance stuff
[/list]

Feels good to be catching up on QA. We've got a few more patches coming in the next week or two, and then there probably will be a bit of a gap while we work on a couple of bigger additions.

notes.title: Build 694
notes.content:
Hey folks! Bunch of small updates this week, including:

[list]
[*] Built a new rendering system for some of the full-screen weather fx

notes.title: Overland v1.1
notes.content:
Folks, it's time for Overland v1.1! The biggest change here is major improvements to inventory management and trading, but there's a bunch of other gameplay fixes in there too.

[list]
[*] [b]Inventory Organizer:[/b] swap items while you're in a car! [i]Or at a campfire![/i]
[*] [b]Trade Interface:[/b] use the inventory organizer at trading sites!
[*] [b]Drag and Drop Inventory:[/b] yes, even on gamepad!
[*] [b]LOOT Action:[/b] recover that backpack when your Bad Driver suffers an "accident"!
[*] [b]PILE IN Action:[/b] get everyone back in the car in one easy move!
[*] Save file upgrading should actually work now
[*] Relaxed fuel combining constraints
[*] Fixed some action preview flickers
[*] Title screen audio improvements
[*] Table improvements
[*] Various other bug fixes
[/list]

We're already getting started on Overland v1.2 and will continue to share news and plans about that as those things come together. Thanks!

notes.title: Build 646
notes.content:
Hey folks, we're wrapping up this week's maintenance with a new location - the city trading camp, which means an extra shot at another backpack before you head out into the woodlands!

[list]
[*] Added a trading camp to the city biome
[*] Updated camp invite and NPC options
[*] More camera improvements
[/list]

Earlier this week we added a ton of fixes for the new Stun gameplay, the level camera behavior, and more fixes for the level generator RNG issues. Maintenance patches will probably drop off for the next week or two while we work on some new inventory management stuff, so thanks in advance for your patience.

notes.title: Build 632
notes.content:
Hey folks! Sorry for the delay - we wanted to get a little extra QA in and also got sidetracked doing some weird code signing stuff that may or may not have actually worked. ANYWAYS:

[list]
[*] Fixed accidental roadblocks

notes.title: Build 628
notes.content:
Hey folks - fresh patch here for your weekend adventures!
[list]
[b][*] Stunning: impact effects like explosions will stun creatures, freezing them for one turn.
[*] Auto Bail-out: survivors will try to jump out of any car that is about to explode.
[*] Rebalanced all blockades

notes.title: Difficulty Tweaks, UI Upgrades, and Streaming Fixes
notes.content:
Hey folks! I wanted to just take a minute to give an overview of the updates that we put together this week. We've been listening, watching, and working to address some of the most glaring issues that made it past us toward the end of development, and I'm really excited for folks to spend time with the version of the game that's up here now. We were at build number 600 for launch day, and are already at build number 622.

[b]Some of the improvements include:[/b]

[list]
[*] Major fixes to the Twitch integration, including better support for map voting, viewer role-play, and more.
[*] A new confirmation popup if you're thinking about leaving a level without the rest of your group.
[*] Big upgrades to the Inspect window's functionality.
[*] Ground items get contextual outlines as you play.
[*] Complete overhaul for d-pad / arrow-key inputs.
[*] Variety of pacing and difficulty adjustments.
[*] Improvements to the AI scavengers.
[*] New camera axis settings.
[*] Reworked intro levels.
[/list]

We've got a lot more stuff planned, but it seems like these changes are making a big difference already. Good luck out there!

notes.title: Build 622
notes.content:
Hey folks! Thanks for your patience. Super happy with today's patch:

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue with attachment detachment. Detach away, detachers!
[*] Driving or walking out with abandons will trigger a confirmation popup now.
[*] INSPECT includes ground items now, and show's more item status.
[*] Updated full bottle's 3D model to differentiate from empty bottle more.
[*] Built-in screenshot function should take the post-processing into account now.
[*] Turning off the car engine is faster now.
[*] Various other bug fixes.
[*] Audio adjustments.
[*] Streaming fixes.
[/list]

We have some more PC-specific quality-of-life stuff coming but hopefully we can go into a slightly less frantic maintenance cadence for the next little bit here!

notes.title: Build 616

[/list]

We've got a couple more basic quality-of-life things in the pipe for tomorrow too.
